alt: AI-generated fictional fashion editorial of four adult women smiling and clasping hands on cushioned seats in a tiled-roof stone courtyard. A braided woman in an ivory-and-red mini sits at left; the blonde and dark-haired women wear red, white and blue Croatian-flag outfits, and the fourth wears an ivory-and-blue mini. Rainbow boots and red or neutral sandals mix beneath the group. Distant fires, smoke and mushroom-shaped clouds are invented scenery, not a real event.
